title: WORKS WELL
text: WORKS WELL. Works perfectly. Sturdy and good to look at. Holds everything in place. The blades were beginning to become a problem, because they are sharp. Now I have a place to put them and that is wonderful.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart FP-12BKSC Elite Collection 12-Cup Accessory Storage Case for Food Processors, Black, 7"T x 9"W
features: CONVENIENT: Compact storage case neatly contains your food processor accessory pieces

COMPATIBLE WITH: Designed for use with Cuisinart FP-12, FP-12BK or FP-12DC food processors – sold separately – this handy case offers a tidy and accessible way to store the multiple food-processor accessory pieces
DURABLE: Made with a plastic construction, small drawer and upper compartment with hinged lid
COMPARTMENTS HOLD: Slicing and shredding discs, chopping, dough blades and more
LIMITED 1-YEAR WARRANTY: Refer to user manual for troubleshooting steps and questions surrounding warranty policies – this product is BPA free
description: Designed for use with Cuisinart FP-12, FP-12BK, or FP-12DC food processors (sold separately), this handy case offers a tidy and accessible way to store the multiple food-processor accessory pieces that otherwise clutter kitchen cupboards. The compact unit features a lower sliding drawer that closes tightly into its recessed housing, while its transparent, hinged lid opens to reveal multiple compartments for accessories--everything from adjustable slicing discs and reversible shredding discs to large and small chopping blades, dough blades, and stem adapters. Even more, both compartments can be quickly secured with the twist of an onboard knob built into the upper lid, keeping sharp pieces safely contained and everything neatly organized. Constructed of durable, wipe-clean plastic for attractive storage from one use to the next, the food-processor accessory case measures approximately 11-1/2 by 10-4/5 by 8-2/5 inches.
